svg.title: Burrard Inlet: the far shore as a low band of plain masses and conifers with two port gantry cranes, then open salt water in three flat tones with straight ripple bars, a small passenger ferry and a moored bulk carrier. World y 860..1160, opaque from its own top edge, which is where the North Shore tile's opaque band ends, so the seam closes at every tier. Water MEASURED at hsl(204,29%,22%) on refs/vancouver/canada-place-and-the-north-shore.jpg against water-shade's hsl(210,65%,29%). Every object here is a TYPE - this tile repeats every 1800 px, so no ship, crane or building on it may be a particular one.
